info.name: TelosFM Bridge
info.author: TelosFM
info.description: Not a hardware controller. Reports Aux PLAY buttons, Aux/deck volumes, deck play state and the crossfader over a loopMIDI port so now_playing.py knows which sources are actually on air, and switches Live Broadcasting and Auto DJ on 30 s after Mixxx starts. Load it on the "TelosFM Bridge" loopMIDI port.
